name: dolzhok
description: Telegram bot that tracks how much one person owes another for Ozon purchases: both drop links, the executor orders with their own card, the bot keeps the ledger. aiogram, Clean Architecture, Vercel webhook + Neon Postgres.

paragraphs: Customer and executor drop Ozon links → the executor orders with their own card → the bot tracks how much the customer owes back.
The bot runs 24/7 on Vercel (webhook, FastAPI ASGI) + Neon Postgres. Locally — long polling and a SQLite file. The MacBook is for development only.
features: Customer and executor: both send links, both use /list and /debt.
Executor: buttons 1 New | 2 Ordered | 3 Received | 🚫 Cancel | ✏️ Price | 🔢 Qty (plus ↩️ Reopen on closed/cancelled items), commands /debt /stats /pay /payments.

Menu buttons: 📋 List, 💰 Debts, 📊 Stats, ❌ Cancel (plus /menu, /cancel). 💰 Debts immediately shows the debt summary and an action submenu: 💰 Debt, 📜 Repayments and (for the executor) ➕ Debt, ✏️ Past debt, 🗑 Reset…
Repayments: the executor sends 💸 Repay (amount + optional comment), the debt shrinks, the ledger lives in 📜 Repayments (deleting a wrong entry asks for confirmation).

Past-orders debt: ➕ Debt adds an untracked amount (a negative value subtracts), ✏️ Past debt overwrites the whole figure (typo fix), 🗑 Reset debt zeroes it with confirmation. It counts in the debt and the balance but…

whatItDoes.text: Customer and executor drop Ozon links → the executor orders with their own card → the bot tracks how much the customer owes back.
